learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state specifically powers down the electrical circuits of the main link to achieve deeper energy savings within the L1 tier?
learnings.learning: In PCIe power management, L1.1 is a deeper substate of L1 where additional components, specifically the electrical circuits of the main link, are powered down to increase power savings at the expense of wake-up time.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, which Arabic term designates humanity's role as stewards or caretakers of the Earth?
learnings.learning: In Islamic philosophy, human purpose centers on three interconnected roles: worshiping Allah, serving as stewards (khalifah) of the Earth, and preparing for the eternal Hereafter through conscious moral accountability.

learnings.question: Approximately what percentage of the total text of the Quran is made up of its 20 most frequently occurring words?
learnings.learning: Contrary to the traditional 80/20 Pareto Principle expectation, the top 20 most frequently occurring words in the Quran account for only approximately 20.83% of its total text.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: In Scrum, which ceremony involves the team demonstrating completed work to the Product Owner and discussing improvements for future Sprints?
learnings.learning: In the Scrum framework, the Sprint Review ceremony is dedicated to demonstrating completed work to the Product Owner and reflecting on the Sprint to identify improvements for future cycles.
